content.json:
## usnewsmap pipeline
The ingest and backfill jobs, from their console lines in `ContainerAppConsoleLogs` and the platform's events in `ContainerAppSystemLogs` (08 §8.1.2). Times are UTC. The release history, the release picker and the version tiles cover the last 30 days (the workspace's retention); everything else follows the time range. The saved queries in `ops/queries/` read the same lines.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.label: Release
parameters.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "ingest"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "building index"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "building index"
| summarize Started = max(TimeGenerated) by value = tostring(j.fields.version)
| order by Started desc
| take 50
| extend label = strcat(value, " (", format_datetime(Started, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC)"), selected = row_number() == 1
| project value, label, selected

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has_any ("curated", "failed", "throttled", "rate limiting", "backing off", "released", "pushed back")
| extend Message = tostring(parse_json(Log).fields.message)
| summarize
    Curated = countif(Message == "curated"),
    Failed = countif(Message == "curation failed"),
    Throttled = countif(Message in ("throttled; downloads pause for an hour", "LoC is rate limiting; stopping until the next run")),
    FetchRetries = countif(Message == "fetch failed; backing off"),
    Pushbacks = countif(Message == "Quickwit pushed back; retrying"),
    Releases = countif(Message == "released")
| mv-expand Tile = pack_array(
    pack("Name", "Batches curated", "Value", Curated),
    pack("Name", "Curation failures", "Value", Failed),
    pack("Name", "LoC rate-limit pauses", "Value", Throttled),
    pack("Name", "Download retries", "Value", FetchRetries),
    pack("Name", "Quickwit pushbacks", "Value", Pushbacks),
    pack("Name", "Releases", "Value", Releases))
| project Name = tostring(Tile.Name), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Batches and releases in the time range

content.query:
// "published" is logged once current.json names the new version; "released"
// (with pages and full) follows only if the writer lease is then released.
let lines = ContainerAppConsoleLogs
    | where ContainerName == "ingest"
    | where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
    | where Log has_any ("published", "released")
    | extend j = parse_json(Log)
    | extend Message = tostring(j.fields.message)
    | where Message in ("published", "released")
    | extend Version = tostring(j.fields.version);
let released = lines
    | where Message == "published"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Version)
    | join kind=leftouter (
        lines
        | where Message == "released"
        | project Version, Pages = tolong(j.fields.pages), Full = tobool(j.fields.full)
    ) on Version
    | project Name = "Published version", Value = Version,
        Detail = strcat(iff(isnull(Pages), "", strcat(Pages, " pages, ", iff(Full, "full", "delta"), ", ")),
            format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC"), Order = 1;
let serving = AppMetrics
    | where Name == "api.index_version"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Properties)
    | project Name = "API serving", Value = tostring(Properties.index_version),
        Detail = strcat("reported ", format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC"), Order = 2;
union released, serving
// Ungrouped arg_max returns one row of nulls when nothing matched.
| where isnotempty(Value)
| order by Order asc
| project Name, Value, Detail
content.title: Index version (last 30 days)
content.noDataMessage: No release and no API report in the last 30 days.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has_any ("curated", "curation failed", "throttled")
| extend Message = tostring(parse_json(Log).fields.message)
| where Message in ("curated", "curation failed", "throttled; downloads pause for an hour")
| summarize
    Curated = countif(Message == "curated"),
    Failed = countif(Message == "curation failed"),
    Throttled = countif(Message startswith "throttled")
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Batches per hour: curated, failed, throttled

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "ingest"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "pushed back"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "Quickwit pushed back; retrying"
| summarize Pushbacks = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), Status = tostring(j.fields.status)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Quickwit pushbacks per 10 minutes, by HTTP status
content.noDataMessage: No Quickwit pushbacks in the time range.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "curated" and Log has "secs"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "curated"
| extend Minutes = todouble(j.fields.secs) / 60
| where isnotnull(Minutes)
| summarize Batches = count() by Minutes = bin(Minutes, 5)
| order by Minutes asc
content.title: Curation time per batch (batches per 5-minute bucket)
content.noDataMessage: No curated batches with timings in the time range.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "curated" and Log has "archive_mb"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "curated"
| extend ArchiveMb = todouble(j.fields.archive_mb)
| where isnotnull(ArchiveMb)
| summarize Batches = count() by ArchiveMb = bin(ArchiveMb, 100)

content.title: Archive size per batch (batches per 100 MB bucket)
content.noDataMessage: No curated batches with archive sizes in the time range.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "ingest"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has_any ("building index", "release progress", "published", "released", "command failed")
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| extend Message = tostring(j.fields.message)
| where Message in ("building index", "release progress", "published", "released", "command failed")
| summarize
    Started = minif(TimeGenerated, Message == "building index"),
    Published = minif(TimeGenerated, Message == "published"),
    Released = minif(TimeGenerated, Message == "released"),
    FailedAt = minif(TimeGenerated, Message == "command failed"),
    LastLine = max(TimeGenerated),
    Version = take_anyif(tostring(j.fields.version), Message == "building index"),
    Full = take_anyif(tobool(j.fields.full), Message == "building index"),
    Batches = take_anyif(tolong(j.fields.batches), Message == "building index"),
    Pages = take_anyif(tolong(j.fields.pages), Message == "released"),
    Docs = take_anyif(tolong(j.fields.docs), Message in ("published", "released")),
    Error = take_anyif(substring(tostring(j.fields.error), 0, 300), Message == "command failed")
    by Replica = ContainerGroupName
| where isnotempty(Started)
// "published" means current.json names the version; "released" follows once
// the writer lease is released, and a failure in between is shown as such.
| extend Status = case(
    isnotempty(Released), "released",
    isnotempty(Published) and isnotempty(FailedAt), "published; cleanup failed",
    isnotempty(Published), "published",
    isnotempty(FailedAt), "failed",
    LastLine > ago(10m), "running",
    "stopped without a result")
| extend Minutes = round(todouble(datetime_diff("second", coalesce(Released, Published, FailedAt, LastLine), Started)) / 60, 1)
| project Started, Version, Type = iff(Full, "full", "delta"), Status, Minutes, Batches, Docs, Pages, Replica, Error
| order by Started desc
| take 100
content.title: Releases (last 30 days): from "building index" to "published" and "released"
content.noDataMessage: No release started in the last 30 days.

content.json:
### Release {Release}
From its `release progress` lines, logged every 30 s and after each batch. Pick another release above.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "ingest"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "release progress" and Log has "{Release}"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "release progress" and tostring(j.span.version) == "{Release}"
| project TimeGenerated, DocsSent = tolong(j.fields.docs_sent), DocsExpected = tolong(j.fields.docs_expected)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Documents sent and expected
content.noDataMessage: No progress lines for this release.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has_any ("WARN", "ERROR")
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| extend Level = tostring(j.level)
| where Level in ("WARN", "ERROR") and tostring(j.target) != "quickwit"
| extend Batch = coalesce(tostring(j.fields.batch), tostring(j.span.batch), extract(@"/ocr/([^/?]+)\.tar", 1, tostring(j.fields.url)))
| where isnotempty(Batch)
| summarize
    Errors = countif(Level == "ERROR"),
    Warnings = countif(Level == "WARN"),
    Messages = make_set(tostring(j.fields.message), 5),
    LastError = take_anyif(substring(tostring(j.fields.error), 0, 300), Level == "ERROR"),
    First = min(TimeGenerated),
    Last = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Batch
| order by Errors desc, Last desc
| take 200
content.title: Warnings and errors by batch
content.noDataMessage: No batch warnings or errors in the time range.

content.query:
let console = ContainerAppConsoleLogs
    | where ContainerName in ("ingest", "curate")
    | where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
    | where Log has "command failed"
    | extend j = parse_json(Log)
    | where tostring(j.level) == "ERROR" and tostring(j.fields.message) == "command failed"
    | project TimeGenerated, Job = coalesce(ContainerAppName, JobName), Replica = ContainerGroupName,
        Source = "command failed", Detail = substring(tostring(j.fields.error), 0, 500);
let platform = ContainerAppSystemLogs
    | where JobName startswith "caj-usnm-" or ContainerAppName startswith "caj-usnm-"
    | where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
    | where Reason in ("BackoffLimitExceeded", "DeadlineExceeded")
        or (Log contains "terminated with exit code" and Log !contains "exit code '0'")
    | project TimeGenerated, Job = coalesce(JobName, ContainerAppName), Replica = ReplicaName,
        Source = Reason, Detail = substring(Log, 0, 500);
union console, platform
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Job failures: "command failed" lines and replicas the platform saw fail
content.noDataMessage: No job failures in the time range.
